name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies has spent over two decades immersed in the world of aerodynamics, a passion ignited during his childhood watching Formula 1 races with his father. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he quickly gravitated towards motorsport, securing an entry-level position at a small racing team before eventually joining Nostalgia Racing. 

Alistair's meticulous approach to wind tunnel testing is legendary within the team. He believes that even the smallest detail can make a significant difference on the track, and he's known for his relentless pursuit of data accuracy. His dedication to uncovering hidden aerodynamic advantages, combined with his years of experience, makes him an invaluable asset to Nostalgia Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a slightly stocky build and intense, focused eyes.

quirks: Always wears the same lucky tie on wind tunnel test days.
Meticulously organizes his workspace, with every tool in its designated spot.
Can often be found sketching aerodynamic concepts on napkins during lunch breaks.
